fact: The party is ambushed by invisible duergar slavers while navigating the Darklake.
source_quote: The party is ambushed by invisible duergar slavers while navigating the Darklake
subject: ambush initiated

fact: Buppido attempts to hide as the party realizes they are being watched.
source_quote: Buppido and Jimjar attempt to hide as the party realizes they are being watched by invisible foes.
subject: Buppido

fact: Jimjar attempts to hide as the party realizes they are being watched.
source_quote: Buppido and Jimjar attempt to hide as the party realizes they are being watched by invisible foes.
subject: Jimjar

fact: Thorin adds a 1d8 superiority die to his initiative via Ambush maneuver, rolling +4 for a total of 12.
source_quote: Thorin uses his tactical expertise to bolster his reaction time as the combat begins. He adds a 1d8 superiority die to his initiative through his Ambush maneuver and rolls +4, bringing him to 12.
subject: Thorin initiative

fact: Daz readies an action to fire Magic Missile at any enemy emerging from the water.
source_quote: Daz readies an action to fire Magic Missile at anything that jumps out of the water.
subject: Daz readied action

fact: The GM explains that invisible duergar become visible once they attack.
source_quote: The GM explains how the party can deal with invisible enemies: ... The duergar become visible once they attack.
subject: GM rules clarification

fact: The GM rules that moving through the water counts as difficult terrain.
source_quote: Moving through the water counts as difficult terrain.
subject: Darklake terrain

fact: Zalthir conjures a 15-foot-radius sphere of magical darkness around one invisible duergar.
source_quote: Zalthir conjures a 15-foot-radius sphere of magical darkness to envelop one of the invisible duergar.
subject: Zalthir darkness cast

fact: The GM remarks that in first edition, darkness could be cast on an enemy's eyes.
source_quote: The GM reminisces that in first edition you could cast darkness on an enemy's eyes.
subject: Darklake rules trivia

fact: Zalthir moves into the water and attacks the invisible duergar, with disadvantage canceled by advantage from his own darkness.
source_quote: Zalthir moves into the water, delivering a series of precise strikes against a duergar despite the visual interference. His disadvantage against the invisible target is canceled by the advantage from his darkness.
subject: Zalthir first strike

fact: Zalthir spends focus points for an extra attack, dealing 9 damage to the duergar.
source_quote: Zalthir spends focus points for an extra attack, dealing 9 damage: "The duergar is pounded."
subject: Zalthir second strike

fact: The duergar targeted by Zalthir has an AC of 16.
source_quote: The duergar has AC 16.
subject: duergar 1

fact: Daz's passive Perception of 14 allows the party to sense another invisible duergar nearby.
source_quote: Daz's passive Perception of 14 lets the party sense that another invisible duergar is lurking nearby.
subject: Daz perception

fact: Thorin pinpoints the second invisible duergar, who remains invisible and thus has disadvantage against attacks.
source_quote: On his turn, Thorin pinpoints him; the duergar stays invisible, so attacks against him still have disadvantage.
subject: Thorin pinpoint

fact: The GM rules that Daz cannot use Magic Missile on a creature he cannot see.
source_quote: The GM rules that Daz can't use Magic Missile on a creature he is merely aware of, because the spell requires a target he can see.
subject: Magic Missile rule

fact: Daz expresses frustration at the ruling regarding Magic Missile visibility requirements.
source_quote: Daz: "Well, that seems like a bunch of BS."
subject: Daz

fact: Thorin notes he has no ranged weapons available.
source_quote: Thorin notes he has no ranged weapons.
subject: Thorin

fact: The GM admits he forgot to give the party crossbows earlier.
source_quote: The GM realizes he meant to give the party crossbows earlier but "forgot to actually say it."
subject: GM oversight

fact: Thorin dives into the water to engage the duergar in melee combat.
source_quote: Thorin dives into the water to engage the duergar in melee combat, using a precision maneuver to land a heavy blow.
subject: Thorin dive

fact: Thorin lands a Feinting Attack for 9 damage, allowed via a GM "gimme" rule despite disadvantage.
source_quote: The GM grants a "gimme," retroactively allowing a Feinting Attack: "I will assume you would have if you had read the rules." The 17 hits for 9 damage.
subject: Thorin precision strike

fact: Daz casts Scorching Ray at the square next to his allies, hitting the duergar for 7 fire damage and leaving it at 1 hit point.
source_quote: He aims Scorching Ray at the square next to his allies. The first two rays miss and the third hits for 7 fire damage, leaving the duergar at 1 hit point.
subject: Daz scorching ray

fact: Daz suggests concentrating fire on the wounded enemy.
source_quote: Daz: "Let's concentrate fire, buddies."
subject: Daz

fact: Gyrgum kills a wounded duergar with Tasha's Caustic Brew after it fails its save.
source_quote: Gyrgum finishes off a wounded duergar by dousing him in a corrosive, acidic brew. The duergar fails its save against Tasha's Caustic Brew.
subject: Gyrgum caustic brew

fact: The duergar killed by Gyrgum's caustic brew is dead.
source_quote: Gyrgum finishes off a wounded duergar by dousing him in a corrosive, acidic brew.
subject: duergar 2

fact: The duergar begin grappling members of the crew, seizing three escapees.
source_quote: The duergar begin grappling members of the crew. Three of the escapees are eventually seized, and the GM marks them with numbers.
subject: crew grappling

fact: Jimjar explains that the duergar kidnap people to sell as slaves in Gracklstugh.
source_quote: Jimjar explains that the duergar kidnap people to sell as slaves in Gracklstugh.
subject: Jimjar

fact: Jimjar states the duergar viewed the party as easy targets.
source_quote: He adds that they must have seen the party as "easy targets, easy pickings."
subject: Jimjar

fact: Thorin asks if Eldeth is among the captives due to a personal interest.
source_quote: Thorin asks whether Eldeth is among the captives, since he has "kind of got a thing for Eldeth."
subject: Thorin

fact: Eldeth is not among the captives taken by the duergar.
source_quote: She is not.
subject: Eldeth status

fact: Thorin rushes to intercept a slaver, dealing 10 damage via Hill Strike, but the duergar saves against being knocked prone.
source_quote: Thorin rushes to intercept a slaver, delivering a heavy blow and attempting to knock the creature off its feet. He deals 9 damage plus 1 from a Hill Strike, for 10 total. The duergar beats the DC 13 Strength save with a 14.
subject: Thorin intercept

fact: Thorin gains Vex status, granting advantage on his next attack.
source_quote: Thorin gains Vex for advantage on his next attack.
subject: Thorin

fact: Zalthir moves his magical darkness sphere up to 60 feet and uses it to blind enemies while seeing through it.
source_quote: Zalthir manipulates the sphere of magical darkness to blind his enemies while seeing through it himself to strike with precision. He moves the sphere up to 60 feet at the start of his turn.
subject: Zalthir darkness manipulation

fact: Zalthir hits a duergar in darkness for 9 and then 5 damage.
source_quote: He hits one duergar for 9 and then 5.
subject: Zalthir dark strikes

fact: The duergar hit by Zalthir's darkness strikes has taken 14 damage total.
source_quote: He hits one duergar for 9 and then 5.
subject: duergar 3

fact: Daz hits a now-visible duergar with Magic Missile.
source_quote: Daz hits a now-visible duergar with Magic Missile, drawing "a splur of blood."
subject: Daz magic missile

fact: The duergar targeted by Daz's Magic Missile is visible and has taken damage.
source_quote: Daz hits a now-visible duergar with Magic Missile, drawing "a splur of blood."
subject: duergar 4

fact: Gyrgum casts Toll the Dead on a duergar, who successfully saves.
source_quote: Gyrgum's Toll the Dead is shrugged off by one duergar.
subject: Gyrgum toll the dead

fact: One duergar disengages and flees the combat.
source_quote: One duergar disengages and flees.
subject: duergar flee 1

fact: Gyrgum's attack of opportunity against the fleeing duergar misses.
source_quote: Gyrgum's attack of opportunity misses.
subject: Gyrgum reaction miss

fact: The remaining duergar use innate magic to enlarge themselves to giant proportions.
source_quote: The remaining duergar slavers use their innate magic to enlarge themselves to giant proportions, preparing to flee.
subject: duergar enlarge

fact: One enlarged duergar remains invisible.
source_quote: One stays invisible while enlarged.
subject: enlarged duergar

fact: Buppido, a derro, pretends to be invisible during the battle.
source_quote: Buppido, the derro companion, lies on the ground pretending to be invisible while the battle rages around him.
subject: Buppido

fact: The GM clarifies that Buppido is a derro, not a duergar, and was never actually invisible.
source_quote: The GM corrects himself: Buppido is a derro, not a duergar, so he never actually turned invisible.
subject: GM derro clarification

fact: Buppido points out the GM's error, stating he is a derro.
source_quote: Buppido: "Derro, not a duergar. Can't you tell the difference?"
subject: Buppido

fact: The captive taken by the duergar is Spiderbait, a goblin who helps the party.
source_quote: The GM reveals the captive is Spiderbait, "one of the two goblins that helps you."
subject: Spiderbait

fact: Thorin expresses liking for Spiderbait.
source_quote: Thorin: "Oh, I like that guy."
subject: Thorin

fact: The party keeps the boat and its chest if they kill all the duergar.
source_quote: The GM notes the party keeps the boat and its chest if they kill all the duergar.
subject: prize rules

fact: The GM suggests a captured duergar could be a useful guide.
source_quote: He adds that a captured duergar "might be a useful guide."
subject: duergar guide potential

fact: Thorin hits the enlarged duergar for 8 then 6 damage, but the duergar saves against being knocked prone.
source_quote: Thorin uses a Feinting Attack plus Hill Strike on the enlarged duergar for 8 and then 6 more damage. The duergar saves against prone with a 17.
subject: Thorin vs enlarged

fact: Zalthir kills a duergar with unarmed strikes.
source_quote: Zalthir pummels a duergar with a series of unarmed strikes until it falls ("Finally I killed one")
subject: Zalthir kill 1

fact: The duergar killed by Zalthir is dead.
source_quote: Zalthir pummels a duergar with a series of unarmed strikes until it falls ("Finally I killed one")
subject: duergar 5

fact: Daz finishes off a duergar with Magic Missile, dealing 6 force damage to a target with 2 hit points.
source_quote: Daz finishes off another with Magic Missile. The duergar Daz kills had only 2 hit points left and took 6 force damage.
subject: Daz kill 1

fact: The duergar killed by Daz shrinks to normal size and falls into the water leaving blood.
source_quote: He shrinks to normal size as the magic ends and falls into the water, leaving floating blood.
subject: duergar 6

fact: Gyrgum shouts a command to leave one enemy out of darkness.
source_quote: Gyrgum, frustrated by the darkness, shouts "Leave one of them not in darkness."
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Gyrgum repeatedly coats the fleeing duergar in acid, causing 2d4 damage at the start of each turn.
source_quote: Gyrgum repeatedly coats the fleeing duergar in a caustic, acidic brew, causing them to burn over time. The acid deals 2d4 at the start of each turn, marked by a red dot on the token.
subject: Gyrgum caustic pursuit

fact: A duergar drops Spiderbait to prioritize his own escape.
source_quote: One duergar attempts to flee with Spiderbait but eventually drops the prisoner to prioritize his own escape.
subject: Spiderbait dropped

fact: The GM describes the third duergar as abandoning the prisoner to run.
source_quote: The GM describes duergar number three as "like, screw this prisoner stuff. I'm running out of here."
subject: GM

fact: Thorin hits a duergar for 6 damage with advantage from Vex.
source_quote: Thorin hits for 6 with advantage from Vex
subject: Thorin hit

fact: Thorin misses an Action Surge attack.
source_quote: then misses an Action Surge attack.
subject: Thorin miss

fact: Zalthir kills another duergar with 4 damage followed by a finishing blow.
source_quote: Zalthir kills another duergar (4 damage, then the finishing blow).
subject: Zalthir kill 2

fact: The duergar killed by Zalthir's second kill is dead.
source_quote: Zalthir kills another duergar
subject: duergar 7

fact: Zalthir's follow-up attack without advantage misses.
source_quote: His follow-up without advantage misses.
subject: Zalthir miss

fact: Daz fires a crossbow at the enlarged, invisible last duergar with disadvantage and misses.
source_quote: Daz fires a crossbow with disadvantage at the enlarged, invisible last duergar and misses.
subject: Daz crossbow miss

fact: Gyrgum casts Caustic Brew again on the last duergar, dealing 8 acid damage.
source_quote: Gyrgum's second Caustic Brew on the last duergar leaves him "doubly acidified," and he takes 8 acid damage.
subject: Gyrgum double acid

fact: The last duergar is doubly acidified and has taken 8 acid damage.
source_quote: Gyrgum's second Caustic Brew on the last duergar leaves him "doubly acidified," and he takes 8 acid damage.
subject: duergar 8
